prompt: Create an event registration form for a tech conference. Collect full name, email, and dietary preferences with vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and no-restrictions choices.
Build a dynamic reading log. Ask how many books were read and show that many sets of inputs for the book name, release date, and author.
Create a participant form that asks for age. Adults should enter occupation; minors should enter a guardian name.
Make a two-page profile wizard. The first page collects full name and email. The second collects website and preferred contact method.
Generate a job application with full name, email, and a required resume upload accepting PDF or document files up to 10MB.
Create an order calculator with quantity and unit price, plus a computed total equal to quantity multiplied by unit price.
Create a department selector loading choices from https://example.invalid/departments and map name as label and id as value.
Build a product feedback form with email, a 1-to-5 rating selector, topics of interest, and comments.
Create a required email signup form that submits with POST to https://example.invalid/signup.
